task: Week 2: detection-only validator on impossible-value items
design: paired: the same 20 notes with BP 80/140 and 140/80
primary_measure: flagged_planted_defect - the response names the BP inversion. A verdict of "inconsistent" for an unrelated reason is not a detection of the planted defect.
format_note: The semantic_ambiguous arm was run before the format string was logged, so those rows read "unrecorded". get_completion() uses format only to build the cache key; it is never sent to the model. The two arms are therefore comparable.
